'''Parnax'''<ref name="Codex" /> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="Species" /> who held the title of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Parnax was deeply unpopular even among his own family, and he spent his brief career as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] betraying every one of his allies and accumulating a long list of powerful enemies.<ref name="Codex" />

Around [[3683 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Parnax, believed by some to either have been incredibly arrogant or incredibly stupid, deliberately broke into the [[Dark Temple]], a forbidden Sith structure on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] that had been sealed for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], in search of the key to the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] power. Parnax recorded his experiences in several journals, chronicling his descent into madness as he found himself unable to leave the Temple and discovered the Emperor's [[Emperor's ritual crisis|plans]] to extinguish all life in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Parnax ultimately committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]], as he believed he could survive the coming darkness by merging with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Parnax was originally slated to be the focus of a Codex entry in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]], but the entry was removed before the game's release in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
